working_definition: Author type 'T5c' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 3 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in an upwards direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: 'T5c' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00003739 'T5c neuron'.
